components.name: Embedded Linux Base Platform
components.description: Embedded-Linux distribution base layer. Includes the kernel, bootloader, and root filesystem.

components.name: BusyBox
components.description: Collection of core embedded-Linux utilities. Provides boot scripts and diagnostic shell commands.

components.name: Dropbear SSH
components.description: Lightweight SSH server. Provides field engineers a remote diagnostic shell access path.

components.name: wpa_supplicant
components.description: Supplicant performing WPA2/WPA3 authentication and key exchange for the wireless backhaul link.

components.name: Expat
components.description: Streaming XML parser. Used to process device-description files and project configurations.

components.name: Das U-Boot
components.description: Bootloader. Handles firmware-image integrity verification and kernel loading.

components.name: zlib
components.description: Lossless compression library used to compress/decompress firmware images and logs.

components.name: lighttpd
components.description: Lightweight HTTP server providing the device's built-in web configuration screen.

components.name: D20 Configuration Store Service
components.description: Service that persistently stores project configuration, tag definitions, and user-account information, and verifies their integrity.

components.name: D20 Redundancy Management Module
components.description: Module that manages state synchronization between the redundant pair and seamless failover.

components.name: D20 Alarm and Event Engine
components.description: Engine that performs threshold monitoring, alarm-priority determination, and acknowledge/clear state management.

components.name: D20 I/O Scanner Module
components.description: Scanner module responsible for periodic data exchange with remote I/O and field modules.

components.name: D20 Embedded Web Configuration UI
components.description: Embedded web application providing browser-based configuration and status-monitoring screens.

components.name: DNP3 Outstation Stack
components.description: DNP3 outstation implementation. Handles event-class polling and unsolicited responses.

components.name: IEC 61850 MMS Server Stack
components.description: IEC 61850 MMS server. Provides the logical-node data model and report control blocks.

components.name: Modbus/TCP Protocol Stack
components.description: Modbus TCP server/client functionality. Handles register and coil access requests.
